'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Chris Haglund DS Knowledge And Defense (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Haglund]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Knowledge And Defense (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-knowledgeanddefense-pre.gif|label=Knowledge And Defense (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
